items.text: Rams WR Puka Nacua is officially active vs Raiders despite calf injury that limited/missed practice.
items.why: Official active report; Rams confident pregame per Rapoport.
items.implication: Start with confidence; high target share expected with Adams out long-term.
items.opportunity: Primary WR1 role, routes/targets elevated without Davante Adams.

items.text: Jets RB Breece Hall officially inactive; was GTD/pessimistic after limited practice returning from quad.
items.why: Unlikely pregame then confirmed inactive; not full participant yet.
items.opportunity: Increased carries/snaps for Jets backup RBs.

items.text: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson OUT; was close but ruled out, Huntley starts. Expected next week.
items.why: High ankle sprain; close to playing but held out.
items.implication: Sit Lamar; Ravens pass game downgraded, Henry/Flowers still viable but less upside.
items.opportunity: Tyler Huntley streamer spot; more designed runs possible for backs.

items.text: Eagles WRs DeVonta Smith and Dontayvion Wicks ruled OUT for MNF vs Cowboys.
items.implication: Major upgrade for remaining Eagles pass catchers and Saquon if active.
items.opportunity: Elevated targets/routes for Goedert, other WRs; more checkdowns possible.

items.text: Jonah Coleman (1st game back) led Broncos backfield: 50% snaps, 41% rush share, 34% routes; Dobbins only 21% snaps. Berry loves long-term.
items.why: Post-game snap/rush/route shares; preseason roster call confirmed.
items.implication: Coleman upgrade to must-roster/startable; Dobbins downgraded.
items.opportunity: Coleman lead role expansion, goal-line potential.

items.text: Vikings RB Aaron Jones knee injury from Sunday not significant; day-to-day.
items.implication: Likely plays next week; Mason handcuff elevated short-term.
items.opportunity: If sits, Jordan Mason full lead.

items.text: Cam Skattebo actually hurt (hamstring) but not certain severity; was expected lead back pregame vs Texans.
items.why: Postgame observation; Rapoport pre noted lead role resume.
items.implication: Monitor practice; potential limited or sit next week.
items.opportunity: If limited/out, Tracy or other Giants RBs gain carries.

items.text: Jahmyr Gibbs ankle turn on purposeful slide almost certainly fine; no major concern.
items.why: Purposeful slide, common non-injury event; Levitan assessment.

items.text: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley EXPECTED TO PLAY MNF after returning to practice from hamstring; questionable but full participant Saturday.
items.why: Practice progression strong; Eagles report expected.
items.implication: Start if confirmed active; high volume likely with WRs out.
items.opportunity: Lead back snaps/carries/redzone with WR absences boosting checkdowns.

items.text: Packers RB Josh Jacobs activated and expected/active to play after exempt/IR return.
items.why: Activated from exempt list; returns to field.
items.implication: Startable RB; monitor snap share post-layoff.
items.opportunity: Lead back role resumption, goal-line work.

items.text: Texans WR routes: Nico Collins 24/29, Noel 15 (left turf toe), Hutchinson 15, Boutte 13, Marvin Harrison 8, Tank Dell 6 (debut since 2024).
items.why: Dropback route shares with Dell return.
items.implication: Collins remains clear WR1; Dell limited debut role.
items.opportunity: Collins high routes/targets; Dell ramp-up potential ROS.

items.text: Seahawks, Broncos, Vikings, Packers potential suitors for Jonathan Taylor at deadline; Seahawks need weapon beyond JSN, Price (chest) status uncertain eligible W8.
items.why: Schefter trade deadline names; Levitan context on SEA need.
items.implication: Taylor hold/trade value high; landing spot could boost or change role.
items.opportunity: If traded to contender, volume secure; SEA RB depth if Price returns.

items.text: Xavier Worthy ran 33 routes on 36 Mahomes dropbacks (2nd game w/o Rice); high volume but career ceiling note (never 83+ rec yds in 37 games).
items.implication: Volume WR2/flex with Rice out; efficiency limits ceiling.
items.opportunity: Near every-down routes, primary target share.
items.conflict: High routes vs historical low yards efficiency.

items.text: Jets WR routes w/ AD Mitchell back: Garrett Wilson 29, Omar Cooper 23 (efficient 12-248-2 on 52 season routes), Mitchell 18 on 33 dropbacks.
items.implication: Wilson still alpha; Cooper efficiency breakout watch as flex.
items.opportunity: Wilson near-full routes; Cooper rising share.
